results.title: Nepali youth press COP31 presidency for grants to rebuild after disasters
results.content: Activists tell Australian negotiators in Antalya that countries that did little to cause the climate crisis should not have to borrow to recover from it.

results.title: Last-minute push to secure mountain agenda in COP31 outcome
results.content: The latest draft proposes a dedicated programme on mountain regions, but Nepal wants clear commitments on climate adaptation, research and finance.

results.title: Explained: Nepal and India have revived stalled air route talks. Here’s what you need to know
results.content: Kathmandu is pushing for two-way access to the Mahendranagar route, stalled by security concerns and strategic mistrust for years.

results.title: Lumbini Lions and Sudurpaschim Royals eye final spot
results.content: The winners of Qualifier 1 will advance directly to the Nepal Premier League final, while the losing side will get another chance through Qualifier 2.

results.title: Dhiraaj Rajbanshi on filming ‘Himalayan Gold’, a yarsagumba thriller, above 3,800 metres
results.content: The director's debut film, out on Friday, explores a little-seen world of Nepal’s mountain communities. He says the story began with tales of robberies in Rukum highlands.

results.title: Police seize Rs16.7 million in unaccounted cash in Lalitpur
results.content: A team from the Kathmandu Valley Crime Investigation Office recovered the money after receiving information about a suspicious financial transaction.

results.title: Nepal gets India’s approval to import 350MW and export 56MW
results.content: The approval allows the NEA to purchase electricity for up to 17 hours a day to meet winter demand while continuing exports from three hydropower projects.

results.title: Advocates seek sweeping changes to Nepal’s sexual violence laws
results.content: They say the draft bill must broaden the definition of rape, clearly define consent, decriminalise consensual relationships between close-in-age adolescents, ensure equal punishment for marital rape and remove the statute of limitations.

results.title: Nepal considers stricter IPO rules for hydropower projects
results.content: A draft amendment would require projects to complete at least 50 percent of construction before issuing shares, drawing mixed reactions from investors and developers.

results.title: Nepal’s push for mountain climate action features in COP31 draft decision
results.content: The proposal calls for a dedicated programme on mountain regions and climate change, with the issue set to become a regular item on future COP agendas.

results.title: Nepal’s stolen heritage in focus at ‘Bring Me Home’ festival in Bhaktapur
results.content: The fest, which also features an exhibition, brings renewed attention to Nepal’s looted religious artefacts and the communities still waiting for their return.

results.title: Is Nepal’s new Parliament building ready for winter session move-in?
results.content: Seven years after construction began, and with the main contract extended six times, the House chamber still awaits tests and handover.

results.title: Gen Z is on the streets everywhere. What do they want?
results.content: From Kathmandu to Delhi to Belgrade, young protesters share anger over corruption and prices, but little else in the way of organisation or leaders.

results.title: Sudurpaschim coach Misbah-ul-Haq meets Pakistan ambassador
results.content: The former Pakistan captain met Mohammad Aamir Khan in Kathmandu, where the embassy hosted a dinner in his honour.

results.title: How India’s delay is set to leave Rs135m of Nepal’s electricity unsold daily
results.content: A separate 40MW seasonal export arrangement with Bangladesh has also expired, leaving the power utility with surplus electricity it cannot sell abroad and putting millions in daily revenue at risk.

results.title: Why is Tatopani border still closed? Stakeholders say it’s time Kathmandu asked Beijing
results.content: Traders and local representatives want the government to seek an explanation from China and secure a lasting arrangement for the operation of the key trade route.

results.title: New Indian envoy calls on Nepal’s foreign minister
results.content: Ambassador Sudhakar Dalela meets Shisir Khanal at Singha Durbar and discusses the longstanding ties between the two countries.
